criteria.deficiency: Non-blocking observation, shared with the reference and not a failure: the title is interpolated into the OSC payload without sanitizing embedded BEL (\x07) or ESC characters, so a title containing those can terminate the sequence early. The reference has the same behavior, and no requirement asks for sanitizing, so this is not counted against the patch.
